author: vansh_sahay
content:
couple of leanSPHINCS things from this weekend -

the leanVM pin in lean-pq-bindings was from before EthLib switched to the FIPS 205 layout, so py-lean-pq 0.9.0 is signing a scheme that EthLib doesn't specify anymore. opened a [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/lean-pq-bindings/pull/45) to bump it. with that build it reproduces EthLib's known answer and agrees with my go impl on a couple hundred random keys. <@427491045308235776> whenever you get a sec. there's a small patch for execution-specs in the PR body, mostly just the pin and a docstring

while digging into that I noticed EIP-8288 still described the key as root || public parameter, that's fixed now (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12666 merged, thanks). left the same suggestion on [12616](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12616). also 12616's gas rationale is built on 492 permutations and EthLib now says 515, probably worth updating before anyone leans on the 12_600 number

and I wired scheme 3 into geth on top of bogota-devnet-2, draft [here](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/36144), [3957](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3957) fixtures pass through geth's runners and the bogota slice of tests-bogota-devnet v2.0.0 still passes. keeping it draft since devnet-2 rejects scheme 3 today and it shouldnt go in until [12616](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12616) is actually in a devnet spec
